cause_quote: The new catalog handler used `event.description.slice(0, 4096)`, which leaves a lone high surrogate when the cutoff falls inside a surrogate pair.
user_saw: Gateway clients received a malformed event description when the 4,096-unit cutoff split an emoji.
summary: The fix uses `truncateUtf16Safe` to keep surrogate pairs intact at the existing description cap.
reasoning: The path-limited first-parent history places the first appearance of `mcp.events.list` in PR #165399. Its diff adds the handler and shows that the original RPC returned descriptions truncated with a raw UTF-16 slice, matching the malformed response documented in the fix PR.
